leaves.name: Render PDF page on dual-canvas
acceptance: PDF pages render on a PDF canvas layer with an overlay for annotation drawing.
leaves.evidence: PdfCanvas renders each PDF page via pdf.js with task cancellation on page change (lines 113–144). Dual-canvas setup confirmed at lines 48–50.

leaves.name: Calibrate drawing scale (two-point distance entry)
acceptance: Setting calibration by clicking two points and entering a known distance produces a pixelsPerFoot; line measurements match real scale.
leaves.evidence: submitCalibration (831) computes pixelsPerFoot. Toolbar.tsx:38 formats as '1″ = N′'. guardDrawing (530) blocks drawing without calibration.
gaps: No automated test for calibration correctness.

leaves.name: Copy calibration to all / range of pages
acceptance: User can apply calibration to all sheets or a range.
leaves.evidence: Toolbar accepts onCopyCalibration prop. Bulk DB delete+re-insert with no confirmation.
gaps: No confirmation dialog before overwriting pages.

leaves.name: Draw two-point line measurement (LF)
acceptance: Placing a line on a calibrated page produces a length in linear feet stored as an annotation.
leaves.evidence: Line branch accumulates two points, calls lineLength, stores annotation with measurementUnit:'LF'.

leaves.name: Draw multi-point polygon measurement (SF/SY)
acceptance: Placing a polygon on calibrated page shows live SF running total; completing it stores area result.
leaves.evidence: handleDoubleClickAtPos finalizes polygon, calls polygonAreaSF, converts SY if needed. Live SF overlay at line 432.

leaves.name: Prompt for depth on CY polygon and compute volume
acceptance: Completing a CY polygon prompts for depth and stores the cubic yard result.
leaves.evidence: CY branch stores pendingPolygon and opens depth prompt. submitDepth computes volumeCY = (areaSF × depth) / 27.
gaps: No automated test for CY volume.

leaves.name: Place count / point marker annotation (EA)
acceptance: Placing a count marker stores a count annotation keyed to the active pay item.
leaves.evidence: Count branch creates annotation type:'count', measurement:1. Hit-test uses pointToMarkerDistance.

leaves.name: Place text label annotation on canvas
acceptance: Select Label tool, tap anchor point, tap label position, enter text — stored as annotation.
leaves.evidence: Label branch accumulates two points, prompt opens, submitLabel calls onAddAnnotation type:'label'.

leaves.name: Draw segmented / polyline length measurement
acceptance: Segmented length tool accumulates intermediate points and sums segment lengths.
leaves.evidence: ToolMode type (project.ts:92) has only 'line' (2-point). No polyline drawing branch in PdfCanvas. Stream Purpose mentions 'segmented length' but it is NOT implemented.
gaps: No drawing handler for multi-segment line.
No geometry function for summing multi-segment distances.

leaves.name: Select and drag vertex handles to edit placed annotations
acceptance: Selecting an existing annotation shows drag handles; dragging a vertex updates the measurement label in real time.
leaves.evidence: hitTestHandles checks line/polygon/label vertices. handleMouseUp calls onUpdateAnnotation with recalc. Live label recalc at lines 265–269.

leaves.name: Edit annotation metadata (location, notes, manual quantity) on canvas panel
acceptance: Inspector can set location string, notes, and manual quantity override on a selected annotation.
A manual or non-drawable pay item accepts a manual quantity override.
leaves.evidence: Inline panel renders location/notes/manualQuantity bound to onUpdateAnnotation. manualQuantity short-circuits measurement display at line 268.
gaps: MobileAnnotationSheet mobile-specific fields not fully cross-checked.

leaves.name: Delete selected annotation via keyboard (Delete/Backspace)
acceptance: Pressing Delete or Backspace while an annotation is selected removes it.
leaves.evidence: Keyboard handler calls onRemoveAnnotation when Delete/Backspace pressed in 'select' mode.

leaves.name: Undo/redo annotation actions with DB sync
acceptance: Undo (Ctrl+Z) removes the last-placed annotation from both local state and Supabase; redo restores it.
leaves.evidence: undo pops undoStack and reverses DB mutation; redo mirrors. Ctrl+Z/Y wiring in Index.tsx.
gaps: Per-session only; another user's view not rolled back.

leaves.name: Receive annotations from other users in real time without page reload
acceptance: An annotation created by another user appears on the canvas without page reload.
leaves.evidence: Supabase postgres_changes channel on `annotations` filtered by project_id.
gaps: Undo stack not shared across users.

leaves.name: Display GPS position dot and trace polyline on plan canvas
acceptance: GPS calibration with ≥ 2 control points renders a position dot and trace polyline at the correct location.
leaves.evidence: Overlay draw effect renders gpsTracePoints polyline and gpsPosition dot via s() helper.

leaves.name: Calibrate GPS-to-plan affine transform via 2–3 control-point wizard
acceptance: GPS calibration with ≥ 2 control points produces a correct affine transform mapping GPS coords to plan pixels.
leaves.evidence: GpsCalibration.tsx implements wizard; buildGeoCalibration dispatches to solveAffine2/3.
gaps: buildGeoCalibration silently throws on degenerate transforms — no user-visible diagnostic.

leaves.name: Start/stop GPS trace recording
acceptance: User can start and stop GPS trace recording; trace polyline is stored and rendered.
leaves.evidence: GpsTraceControls.tsx exists (234 LOC). Props gpsTracePoints accepted by PdfCanvas.
gaps: Kalman filter wiring not verified end-to-end.

leaves.name: Draw rectangle on canvas to import Table of Contents region
acceptance: User drags a box around the sheet list; app parses sheet numbers and descriptions.
leaves.evidence: tocSelect mode tracks drag rect; drawTocRect renders it; handleImportToc fires onTocRegionSelected. Escape resets state.

leaves.name: Touch pan/pinch-zoom and single-tap drawing on mobile
acceptance: Mobile two-finger pinch zooms; single-finger taps place drawing points; double-tap closes polygon.
leaves.evidence: Pinch-zoom + 1-finger pan/draw routing. Double-tap closes polygon. MobileToolbar provides 2-row tool UI.

leaves.name: Enforce read-only mode hiding edit controls
acceptance: The readOnly flag disables the calibrate tool and hides pay-item edit controls.
leaves.evidence: Toolbar filters out 'calibrate' when readOnly. PdfCanvas receives readOnly and passes to input fields.

docDrift.actual: Correctly implemented — pendingPolygon at 61–63 and submitDepth at 684.

docDrift.actual: ToolMode type (project.ts:92) contains only select|calibrate|line|polygon|pan|tocSelect|count|label. No segmented/polyline mode exists.

docDrift.actual: useProject.ts is 499 LOC — line citations may be stale; channels exist but ranges shifted.
